name: morvs
description: Keyless access to MORVS public-records data for AI agents: US company filings, enforcement, recalls, sanctions and debarment screening, market signals and open datasets, with source-cited answers.

interface.longDescription: Research US companies and institutions across SEC filings, FDA recalls, federal enforcement, contracts, lobbying, courts and more through the keyless MORVS public-records server. Skills cite the record URL and primary source, state dataset freshness, and never treat a non-match as clearance.
defaultPrompt: Summarize Pfizer's regulatory record from the last six months
Screen a vendor against public sanctions and debarment lists
Find an open dataset on federal prison populations
